vault_line: Bugs Bunny nigga got karats and shit (Karats and shit)
bar: Bugs Bunny nigga got karats and shit (Karats and shit)
chip_form: Bugs Bunny nigga got karats and shit (Karats and shit) (savage calls)
note_excerpt: 21 Savage calls himself Bugs Bunny, a fictional bunny who enjoys eating carrots, a homonym of karats which is used in the line and refers to the rating of 21’s jewelry.
